title: Character
description: Character bible (production/characters/<CHAR_ID>/character.yaml): identity, canonical description, the features that separate this character from the rest of the cast, and reference assets.

id.description: Character ID, e.g. CHAR_MARA. Matches the directory name.

name.description: Name as used in the script.

aliases.description: Other names the script uses for the character.

description.description: Canonical physical description. Prompts are compiled from these fields.

summary.description: Canonical appearance in one or two sentences.

distinguishing_features.description: What separates this character from any other in the cast. Must survive every render.

prompt_summary.description: One generation-ready sentence used verbatim in prompts.

visually_adjacent_to.description: Characters this one could be confused with; prompts must state the difference.

voice.description: How the character speaks; informs dialogue.

arc.description: How the character changes across the story.

default_wardrobe.description: Wardrobe state worn unless a panel says otherwise.

wardrobe_file.description: Path of this character's wardrobe.yaml, relative to the character directory.

sheet.description: What the full character sheet (sheet kind model) shows besides the turnaround. Each item is a label lettered on the sheet, optionally followed by a colon and what the drawing shows ("left forearm: a long scar"). Labels are in the project's language.

closeups.description: Labelled close-ups of what identifies the character: a scar, a tattoo, glasses, a ring. Default: the distinguishing features.

poses.description: Labelled expressions and key poses or states the story needs: tired, sitting, fallen. Default: four expressions and poses plus the physical states the pages give the character.

status.description: Approval status of the bible entry.

notes.description: Free-form notes for people. Never read by scripts.
